title: Finite-rank crystal-graph comparison conjecture for finite unitary groups
statement:
Let $t$ be a non-negative integer, set $r=t(t+1)/2$ and $\iota=r\pmod 2$, and let $\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{\iota,q,\ell}^{t,\leq d}$ be the induced subgraph of the reindexed Harish-Chandra branching graph on vertices of rank at most $d$. Let $\mathcal{G}_{\mathbf{c},e}^{\leq d}$ be the corresponding crystal graph truncated at rank $d$. **Graph-comparison conjecture.** Assume that $e$ is odd and put $\mathbf{c}=(t+(1-e)/2,0)$. Then there is an integer $b=b(\ell)$ such that

$$
\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{\iota,q,\ell}^{t,\leq b}=\mathcal{G}_{\mathbf{c},e}^{\leq b},
$$

when the colouring of the edges of the latter graph is ignored.
This conjecture predicts that, up to a bound depending on $\ell$, the relevant Harish-Chandra branching graph agrees with a crystal graph after reindexing. The source gives no resolution.
source_name: Thomas Gerber, Gerhard Hiss and Nicolas Jacon, “Harish-Chandra series in finite unitary groups and crystal graphs”, arXiv:1408.1210 (2014).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1408.1210

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2014).
